content.title: Chapter 30 - ELECTIONS — Sec. 30-68. - Procedure upon resultant vacancy.
content.summary:
In the event that an officer is recalled by a majority vote of those voting on the
               question, the office shall be deemed vacant and shall be filled as provided in
section 4.6
of the Charter.
(Code 1981, § 11-39; Ord. No. 3511, § 2, 2-1-1999)
